sections.title: Executive Summary
sections.body: Sequel to "I'm a Cow" song and animation video (Film & Video, goal $15,000). The committee recommends Do Not Invest at 64% confidence.

body.Name: Sequel to "I'm a Cow" song and animation video

sections.title: Market Opportunity
sections.body: Cautious (score 53/100). Film & Video campaigns fund at 42% vs a 40% platform baseline (lift 1.03). Market timing is neutral; the Film & Video trend is stable (45,162 campaigns). The category is highly crowded.

sections.title: Competitive Position
sections.body: Negative (score 25/100). Ask for less: funded campaigns' median goal is $5,000 vs $10,000 for those that failed. Your $15,000 goal is 3.0x the winners' median ($5,000) — priced like the campaigns that failed. Category is highly crowded — 45,162 campaigns (17% of all).

sections.title: Founder Analysis (creator execution)
sections.body: Cautious (score 53/100). The creator left ~20 points of controllable upside unrealized (23% of a reachable 44%) — craft gaps below. Craft gap: Lower your funding goal from $15,000 to $5,000 (~9 pts). Craft gap: Shorten your campaign from 18 to 30 days (~12 pts).

sections.title: Financial Analysis (funding viability)
sections.body: Cautious (score 44/100). Goal $15,000 is 3.0x the category winners' median ($5,000). Calibrated funding probability 23% vs the 33% decision bar. Goal-size risk (High): Goal $15,000 is 3.0x the Film & Video funded-median ($5,000); large goals are harder to reach.

sections.title: Risk Assessment
sections.body: Negative (score 26/100). Overall risk: High. Modeled failure risk 77%. High — Goal $15,000 is 3.0x the Film & Video funded-median ($5,000); large goals are harder to reach. High — Modeled failure risk 77% (funding probability 23%, below the 33% threshold). 2 investor objection(s) raised; top: goal_size.

sections.title: Investment Thesis
sections.body: The committee recommends Do Not Invest at 64% confidence. Bull case (Market): Film & Video campaigns fund at 42% vs a 40% platform baseline (lift 1.03). Bear case (Competition): Ask for less: funded campaigns' median goal is $5,000 vs $10,000 for those that failed. As presented the campaign is not fundable (23%), but it is fixable — reachable to ~44% with the priority pre-launch changes. Conditional on those fixes the thesis could clear the bar; unchanged, pass.
